primary_scroll_resolution.finding: The short-wide inner fallback no longer inherits the companion route PrimaryScrollController. Portrait outer vertical scroll remains responsible for header, modes, turn label and play content.

sliver_and_text_scale_analysis.preceding_extent: All preceding slivers are finite SliverToBoxAdapter/SliverPadding children. precedingScrollExtent represents their complete laid-out extents, not remainingPaintExtent or the visible fraction. Larger text therefore reserves its actual preceding height without making playHeight oscillate while scrolling.
sliver_and_text_scale_analysis.floor: Portrait playHeight remains at least168.8+84=252.8dp. All seven controls live inside finite content; the 48dp row is not compressed by large preceding text.
sliver_and_text_scale_analysis.footer_budget: companionH+22 exactly reserves the next companion with6+16dp padding.
sliver_and_text_scale_analysis.paint_hit_agreement: Flutter3.44.9 RenderSliverToBoxAdapter calculates paintExtent from scrollOffset/remainingPaintExtent and assigns the same paintedChildSize to hitTestExtent. RenderSliver.hitTest rejects positions outside that visible extent; its child transform uses the same scroll offset.
sliver_and_text_scale_analysis.reachability: A control outside the current painted viewport must first be scrolled into view. The normal scroll extent includes the complete finite play child and following companion; there is no new overlay or separate pointer coordinate system.
sliver_and_text_scale_analysis.runtime_limit: This is source reasoning for a text scaler of2.0 and larger preceding widgets. No actual2.0 layout, pixel, exposed-target or touch result was measured by this reviewer.

retained_render_boundary: Horizontal overflow may clip decorative pedestal overhang, outer glow or right board edge. Core cells/buttons stay in the common content. No clip removal or input-overlay change introduced.
